text: Determining the optimal method to identify a patient as being polytraumatized is important, because trauma scoring has proved to be an important tool in the quality management of patients with acute injuries [ 14 ]. It is likely to become a model for “pay-for-performance” issues in the future. From this perspective, the interobserver reliability investigated in this study is an important tool for assuring good performance, even with economic factors in mind.
source_label: Assessment of polytraumatized patients according to the Berlin Definition: Does the addition of physiological data really improve interobserver reliability?
